title: Chiara Mooney & Shiven Mian – Building for Microsoft (Chain React 2023)
summary: Microsoft engineers Chiara Mooney and Shiven Mian describe the journey and challenges of building and consuming React Native for Windows inside Microsoft. It was given at Chain React 2023.
why: HN cites it as first-party evidence of where Microsoft uses React Native in Windows, particularly the Start Menu.

quote.text: only the Recommended section is build with React Native [1].
